idea-plugin.name: Moldable Exceptions
idea-plugin.description: Lets Java exceptions decide how they are debugged: methods annotated with @DebugView contribute text, diff and table views, shown when the debugger stops on the exception or via Show Moldable Views in the Variables view. A prototype of moldable exceptions (Chiş, Nierstrasz, Gîrba, Onward! 2024; Glamorous Toolkit by feenk).

action.description: Show the views the selected exception declares with @DebugView, plus its causes

action.text: Moldable: Stop at Uncaught Moldable Exceptions
action.description: Stop at the throw of an uncaught exception whose chain has views, without any breakpoint

action.text: Moldable: Open Views at Exception Breakpoints
action.description: Open the moldable views automatically when the debugger stops on a moldable exception
